case.component: FORWARD COLLISION AVOIDANCE: AUTOMATIC EMERGENCY BRAKING
case.narrative: I was crossing the Mackinac Bridge, northbound, this afternoon, at the time traveling over the bridge deck's grates in the left lane. Traffic was backed up and I was traveling in the single-digit MPH. There was more that a car's length between myself and the next car ahead, and as I accelerated a little bit to close the distance my emergency braking activated. Fortunately, the car behind me was trailing by a little bit and was also traveling slowly.

decision.rationale: Quotes verified and no hard rule is broken.
